SELECT
    s.StoreType,
    sum(fs_store.store_sales) AS total_all_channel_sales,
    avg(s.SellingAreaSize) AS average_selling_area_size
FROM
(
    SELECT
        StoreKey,
        sum(SalesAmount) AS store_sales
    FROM retail.FactSales
    GROUP BY StoreKey
) AS fs_store
INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s
    ON fs_store.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
GROUP BY s.StoreType
ORDER BY total_all_channel_sales DESC
